aggregation_contract.level_pass_condition: every required gate in the level must equal passed
aggregation_contract.reviewable_rc_condition: every required_for_review_rc gate must equal passed; blocked L3-L5 gates remain visible and do not become local_byom_verified
aggregation_contract.local_byom_verified_condition: every required L0-L5 gate must equal passed
aggregation_contract.github_released_condition: local_byom_verified plus every required_for_github_release gate must equal passed
aggregation_contract.skipped_policy: skipped is forbidden and must never aggregate to passed

review_candidate_gates.description: Python package, API, CLI and DeepSeek adapter identify the same 0.9 RC line.
The API and UI distinguish registered Recipe training from arbitrary-repository analysis, and report BYOM execution unavailable without verified isolation.
A vague request is clarified one implementation-changing question at a time; the evidence workspace opens on demand and passes desktop/mobile keyboard checks.
Two registered user-data Recipes complete real training, deep verification, evaluation gates and traceable artifacts.
A non-editable wheel installs outside the repository and serves health, runtime, family catalog and app routes.

levels.description: Universal-support semantics, primary object, safety boundary and evidence tiers are machine-readable and truthful.
Hugging Face and GitHub resolve to immutable commits with fail-closed negatives and restart-safe evidence.
A versioned training plan and real resource result are bound to the immutable source before execution.
Untrusted code runs only in a verified, killable isolated worker and can qualify, register and resume the same task.
A newly registered repository trains, evaluates, infers and packages without model-specific frontend branches.
Frozen-source blind testing, negative matrix, browser, process restart and cold reproduction all pass.
The exact verified commit is merged, tagged v0.9.0-rc.1 and published with hashed wheel and sdist assets.
